user_id.description: Key into users.json for looking up dashboard stats.

acknowledged_return.description: True once the user has acknowledged they are back / the welcome has been given.

self_identified_gap.description: Skill area the user themselves identified as a gap through the Socratic review.

recommended_exercise.description: Specific exercise name from the platform recommended based on the self-identified gap.

micro_commitment.description: Whether the user committed to trying the recommended exercise this week.

required_complete.description: Set true by the analyzer when all required fields for the current phase are filled.

phase_suggestion.description: Phase the analyzer detected the conversation should move to.
